articles.summary: The trial, designed and sized to support registration, met its primary endpoint, with the 210/3 mg BID dose demonstrating a statistically significant improvement in PANSS total score compared to placebo at Week 5 with an effect size of 0.37 (LS mean difference vs PBO -4.5, p=0.015) Cognitive
articles.title: MapLight Therapeutics Announces Positive Topline Results from Phase 2 ZEPHYR Trial of ML-007C-MA in Schizophrenia
